name: Kiryuuin Kaede
source:
"I'm not worthy, but please take care of me"

A sudden apartment complex wife (candidate).
A Yamato Nadeshiko with long black hair and wearing a kimono.
Although she is a respectable young lady from a noble family, her strong desire to become an apartment complex wife led her to apply.
She was raised in a household where common sense was somewhat old-fashioned, doing things such as walking three steps behind a man and bowing with three fingers together at the entrance when greeting someone, so she herself has a chaste way of thinking.

Therefore, she is also modest when it comes to sex, but she gradually begins to compete with Ichika, trying not to lose to her advances.

She is skilled enough at general housework that even Ichika has given up on competing there, but she is not good with cats, and it is a source of worry for her that she cannot get in between Hayato and Ichika when they take care of them.
